text: In a desolate industrial city, Henry Spencer goes to dinner with his girlfriend Mary's family, where [a Cornish game hen writhes and gushes blood on the plate|images|food, drink and drugs] and her mother tells him Mary has had his child. The baby is [a swaddled bundle with an inhuman face|archetypes|The Wrong Child] that refuses all food and [cries incessantly in the one-room flat|images|sounds, smells and silence], driving Mary away. Alone with it, Henry drifts into visions of a man pulling levers inside a planet and [a lady in the radiator who sings of heaven|ending|the ending is left open].
